stem:
Neel sees cactus in a dry yard and ferns near a wet wall.

Why do the plants differ in the two places?

options.text: Different places always have different plants, for any reason.
Different conditions of water, heat, and soil support different plants.
Dry yards are dry because cactus and ferns made them dry.
No plant can live in both a dry yard and a wet place.

teacher.key_rationale: Conditions differ between places, so the plants that can live there differ.
